rules.character: all operators (mods made with EFMI-Tools only)
rules.detail: From the GameBanana post: every scope in the ini must now carry a match_index_count to be valid (XXMI 0.8.5 DLL needs it), and new shader and buffer hashes exist only in EFMI 1.2.0+ and XXMI 0.8.0+, so the mod ini hashes are updated per character. Texture LODs are more aggressive in 1.1, so mods without RabbitFX can flicker. The script keeps backups and has --restore. Its data is embedded per character in the source; the exact hash list and edits are unknown to us. Cannot fix: custom ini files, mods already patched by an unofficial fix (revert first), mods not made with EFMI-Tools, non character mods.

Detection hint for installed mods, unverified: the post calls them "scopes" and does not say which ini section that is, most likely the TextureOverride sections that have match_first_index. If so, an ini whose such sections lack a match_index_count line is an older mod that will not load with XXMI 0.8.5+, and a plain text check can show it as "may be broken". Adding the count needs the index buffer size, so do not auto edit it.
